description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Regulations made Under the Section 41 and read with the Section 31 of the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically amending previous regulations published in an earlier gazette. The content involves legal/regulatory matters - amending and repealing specific sections of existing regulations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
